title: TorusGuardProvenanceChain
description: Structured provenance chain tracking discovery and decision path for TorusGuard v0.5.1 findings.

discovery_module.description: Module or rule that initiated the detection (e.g. rules/authorization/TG-AUTH-007).

triggering_input.description: The specific input, AST node, manifest line, or configuration key that triggered detection.

evidence_collected.description: List of evidence identifiers or file locations gathered during discovery.

decision_path.description: Ordered sequence of logical evaluation steps leading to the finding classification.

verification_step.description: Verification method used to confirm or refute the finding.

agent_environment.description: Runtime context (e.g. TorusGuard Engine v0.5.1 on Python 3.11).
